dedupe_keys.name: honduras intercity bus and bay islands ferry gtfs tables

description: This repository publishes transit tables for selected intercity bus companies and ferry routes in Honduras. Its README names the La Ceiba–Roatán, La Ceiba–Utila and Utila–Roatán crossings, several bus operators, and terminal and ferry-wharf coordinates. The public tree includes agency, stops, routes, trips, stop-times and calendar CSV files plus a small Flutter viewer. The author calls this a national open GTFS effort, but the checked tree is a partial selection and uses .csv filenames, not the usual .txt names inside a feed archive; direct use in a GTFS parser may require conversion. The README warns implicitly that timetables change and invites corrections, but gives no measured collection date or validation log. Repository metadata and the README state MIT reuse terms and public access without charge. Simulation use includes sketching intercity and island links after validating schedules with operators. It complements data-transitland with a locally compiled coverage sample; it does not establish full Honduras service coverage. No CSV rows or route timings were inspected.
licence: MIT as stated by repository metadata and README; original operator timetable rights not separately documented.
